purpose: schmitt ckt - ecl compatible schmitt trigger

oracle.derivation: ngspice's ECL Schmitt trigger example. Dropped column(s) i(vin): the two converged references disagree on more than 10% of the rows (pA-level offsets while the circuit is quiet: where each simulator stamps GMIN, and its charge residue). Converged reference: Xyce at timeint reltol 1e-6, nonlinear reltol 1e-7 abstol 1e-15; the previous oracle (ngspice at the deck's options) was 2.58x its tolerance off it on the rows kept.

confirmed.command: ngspice -b deck + .options reltol=1e-7 abstol=1e-15 vntol=1e-12 chgtol=1e-20, .tran tmax 2e-11
